name: node-semver
why: A compact ISC-licensed JavaScript library with years of small version-range fixes and regression fixtures, including [invalid wildcard ordering](https://github.com/npm/node-semver/commit/e583226b165edd6530502cf731eda334527af6fe).

name: date-fns
why: An MIT-licensed JS/TS library with modest repository history and years of localized date, formatting, and locale fixes accompanied by regression tests, including [Chinese month parsing](https://github.com/date-fns/date-fns/commit/b9c5865edb7610c59e6b3694ed1e1691f4807688).

name: yargs-parser
why: A tiny ISC-licensed JS/TS argument parser with years of focused option-handling fixes and regression tests, including [negative numbers with disabled option grouping](https://github.com/yargs/yargs-parser/commit/ccc3634e324458d15789d8e9bd81851b178f21b5).

name: js-yaml
why: A compact MIT-licensed JS/TS YAML parser and serializer with years of small syntax and quoting fixes backed by regression tests, including [whitespace-only block scalars](https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/commit/0cbb471d67b083778e7b2600af2418142bf5bf04).

name: markdown-it
why: A compact MIT-licensed JS/TS Markdown parser with years of localized parsing fixes and readable input/output regression fixtures, including [spaces inside code spans](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/commit/988c82be47391e20040c1c7f40249ac5ba8c5467).

name: decimal.js
why: A small MIT-licensed pure-JavaScript arithmetic library with years of focused rounding and precision fixes accompanied by numerical regression tests, including [inverse-sine precision near one](https://github.com/MikeMcl/decimal.js/commit/02f1e51c3bcb411b2c8b70b177ec704d8aaf4b39).

name: Immutable.js
why: An MIT-licensed JS/TS collections library with repository history comfortably below 500 MB and years of focused collection and iteration fixes with regression tests, including [reversed lazy-sequence indices](https://github.com/immutable-js/immutable-js/commit/bddf631b29436187deb4357cc15dfbb452752a35).

name: jsdiff
why: A compact BSD-3-Clause-licensed JS/TS library with years of small, documented diff and patch fixes accompanied by regression tests, including [arrays returned by toJSON](https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff/commit/bb6a976facc89cbd7daa8b5dd29bac864310ea89).
